about: An open-source ecommerce platform built on WordPress.

prs.title: Stores with some translation files no longer crash
prs.broken: When a language had two or more translation files made with a common WordPress tool, combining them crashed the page with a fatal PHP error.
prs.changed: Each file's strings are now read from the place that file keeps them, and all are merged.
prs.matters: Shops running in another language load normally and keep every translated string.
